GET /projects/212260dd-6687-4bd4-a22f-ce.summary: Decision Making for NPCs in Real-Time Strategy Games Abstract This paper compares Behavior Trees, Utility AI and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for non-player character decisions in real-time strategy games. doi: 10.5555/purnara.sample.2025 Keywords: RTS, MCTS, Utility AI, game AI Real-time strategy games need fast decisions under uncertainty, with many units acting at once. We implement MCTS with a 50 ms budget per decision and compare it with a Utility AI baseline over 200 matches on three maps.
